purpose: Content-addressed pointers for bulky research evidence that is deliberately NOT carried in the mainline tree. Bytes remain retrievable from the immutable git history at the producer commit; every pointer pins the sha256 of the exact bytes. No external artifact may exist without a pinned hash in this registry.

policy.in_git_tree: source code, tests, contracts, schemas, manifests, preregistrations, final_report.md, small final_report.json, hash pointers, and any evidence required by runtime tests
policy.externalized: bulky replay ledgers and large intermediate evidence not required by runtime tests; bytes preserved at the producer commit (git object database) and regenerable deterministically by the producer script
policy.verification: scripts/verify_external_artifacts.py recomputes sha256 of the bytes at each storage location and compares against this registry; any mismatch must fail closed
